content_md:
I find the labyrinth of business models to be a bit more bewildering in this post-LLM world.

For instance, I got nerd-sniped with the concept of AI-native services. But that seems like the wrong model. The worst of both worlds, perhaps.

SaaS is challenged for obvious reasons.

The notion of a business as a protocol rather than a purveyor of a product is intriguing, but in practice, the value capture can be elusive. 

I am spending time thinking about product categories from the past that may find new life amidst new nature.
